posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
You've got two slow-build heroes (Tachyon, Unity), a support hero (Scholar), and one damage dealer (Haka). Since you're playing Baron Blade on advanced, you are in a race.

So, I recommend Haka focuses on doing as much damage as possible, even if that limits his longer-term capabilities because of missed opportunities for extra card draws. If you can get to BB's flip, this game will become relatively easy, but you've got to get there.

The Scholar may need to prepare for tanking lots of damage. Your only way to win may be to leave BB's targets on the field so that the trash doesn't fill, in which case Scholar's ability to direct damage to himself and negate it will become essential.

Tachyon may need to resort to relatively early uses of the Lightspeed Barage. It's likely to be more important to do a couple of 5-point shots and push BB to his other side than to save them for the massive later shots.

Unity has a fantastic start. I don't remember how much BB or the Tomb have in terms of hitting the lowest, but getting Platform and Raptor out early to start doing damage to Blade is fantastic.
